There is no additional two-leaf condition or omitted allowed gluing in this labelled domain.
checks.scope: Q8 leaf-sharing completeness for the cap15 cover domain

checks.method: From the manuscript's literal P10 model, enumerate its automorphisms within S6 and the orbits of omitted block pairs. Independently construct R16 and all sixteen one-triple deletions, testing sunflower-freeness, rho and used-point degrees.
checks.observation: P10 has 60 automorphisms and exactly two deletion-pair orbits: intersection one with size 30 and intersection two with size 15. All R16 deletions are SF3 with rho=7. The twelve outer deletions have degree multiset (3,3,4,4,4,4,5,6,6,6); the four hub deletions have (4,4,4,4,4,4,5,5,5,6), agreeing with LOW15-R15-rho7-classification.md. This checks the classified outputs, not by itself the universal classification implication.

checks.method: Inspect the cover bridge and replay_low15_eight_seven_covers.py; check the receipt's deletion keys and independently reconstruct C3/P4 for three extremal records without importing the producer or replayer.
checks.observation: After at most two deletions at least thirteen triples remain, while two support points meet at most twelve; thus every ambient four-cover uses at least three support points. Triple codegree two and simplicity justify 2|C3|+|P4| even with arbitrary exterior completions. All 21 receipt models have exactly the 121 distinct deletion keys. Independent reconstruction gives P8-i2-H6 with no deletion: C3=0,P4=2; P8-i2-H2 deleting index 8: C3=0,P4=4; P8-i2-H5 deleting indices 8,13: C3=1,P4=8. The resulting capacities are 2,4,10. Other cover contents were not recomputed in this round.

findings.disposition: The pinned paper/main.tex lines 465-516 supply this universal domain, and the new classification and Q8 cover notes retain it. My literal checks reproduce its 175 trace outcomes. The full six-point catalogue enumeration was not rerun.
findings.statement: The imported I7 catalogue is usable independently of the prior cardinality-69 argument: its arbitrary-support reduction and mixed-trace witnesses occur before that argument.

findings.disposition: The cap15 assembly supplies the exclusion dependency; the current reconstruction uses eight P8 intersection-two models and thirteen Q8 gluings. The older 29-link bridge is a broader domain, not evidence of a missing current case. The current receipt has all 121 deletion keys for each of its 21 models.
findings.statement: The current 21-link cap15 cover domain correctly retains permitted Q8 leaf sharing and excludes P8 intersection-one models only through an earlier named ordinary result.

findings.disposition: The reported finite checks are bounded: all 175 mixed traces and 183 Q8 identifications, complete deletion-key coverage, and three independently reconstructed extremal cover records. The wider proof remains subject to subsequent rounds.
findings.statement: The source map distinguishes ordinary geometric bridges from finite predicates, but the checks in this submission do not certify every cover record, proof-tree node or high-degree model row.

revisions.action: Rechecked the revised theorem, conventions and new neighbourhood notation.
revisions.result: The maximum-size/forcing-threshold distinction remains correct, and N[max] now explicitly quantifies over every actual member. The previously resolved framing finding remains resolved.

revisions.action: Inspected the added obligation table and its cap15 assembly references.
revisions.result: The map now directly locates the whole-completion exterior bound, derived eleven-point support and separate finite trees. My prior limitation concerning unreplayed motif exclusions and trees remains; no earlier required revision was outstanding.

revisions.action: Traced the structural imports into the pinned source and rechecked the retained assurance statements.
revisions.result: The inspected import scopes agree with their uses. H27 ledger reproduction, external proof reconstruction and exhaustive priority remain outside this review's claims.

content.summary: The source map is sufficient to trace the inspected structural imports and low-degree domains. Direct checks reproduce all 175 I7 mixed-trace entries, the 13 permitted Q8 gluings among 183 identifications, both P8 deletion orbits, and representative cover capacities. The arbitrary-support cover transfer is sound. No new defect requiring revision was found in this scope; continue the remaining proof and certificate audit.
